mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defense_records) AS totalDefenses, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defense_records WHERE status = 'completed') AS completedDefenses, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defense_records WHERE status = 'pending') AS pendingDefenses, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defense_topics) AS totalTopics, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'student') AS totalStudents, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(score), 1) FROM defense_records WHERE score IS NOT NULL) AS avgScore

SELECT t.topic_id AS topicId, t.topic_name AS topicName, COUNT(r.defense_id) AS defenseCount FROM defense_topics t LEFT JOIN defense_records r ON r.topic_id = t.topic_id GROUP BY t.topic_id, t.topic_name ORDER BY defenseCount DESC, t.topic_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM defense_records WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT t.topic_id AS topicId, t.topic_name AS topicName, t.defense_time AS defenseTime, COALESCE(u.name, '') AS teacherName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM defense_questions q WHERE q.topic_id = t.topic_id) AS questionCount, COUNT(DISTINCT r.defense_id) AS defenseCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status = 'completed' THEN r.defense_id END) AS completedCount, ROUND(AVG(r.score), 1) AS avgScore FROM defense_topics t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = t.teacher_id LEFT JOIN defense_records r ON r.topic_id = t.topic_id GROUP BY t.topic_id, t.topic_name, t.defense_time, u.name ORDER BY defenseCount DESC, t.topic_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT dr.defense_id AS defenseRecordId, u.name AS userName, u.user_number AS userNumber, dt.topic_name AS topicName, dr.score AS score, dr.status AS status, dr.defense_date AS defenseTime FROM defense_records dr JOIN users u ON dr.user_id = u.user_id JOIN defense_topics dt ON dr.topic_id = dt.topic_id WHERE dr.topic_id = #{topicId} ORDER BY dr.defense_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}
